# Zoetis

> > Zoetis is a global animal health leader providing innovative medicines, vaccines, diagnostics, and digital solutions across petcare, livestock, equine, and aquaculture sectors.

Zoetis is a Fortune 500 company with over 70 years of experience advancing animal care through cutting-edge research, including monoclonal antibody technology. The company operates globally with manufacturing facilities and customer support networks, while maintaining strong commitments to sustainability and veterinary education.

## Key Topics

- Animal Health
- Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs)
- Petcare Products
- Livestock Solutions
- Equine Products
- Aquaculture
- Diagnostics
- Vaccines
- Research & Development
- Sustainability
- Veterinary Medicine
- Disease Prevention
- Continuum of Care
- Zoetis Foundation
- Fortune 500

## Product Categories

- [Zoetis Petcare Products & Solutions](https://www.zoetis.com/products-and-science/petcare): Zoetis petcare: Librela, Simparica TRIO, Apoquel for dogs and cats
- [Zoetis Livestock Products & Solutions](https://www.zoetis.com/products-and-science/livestock): Zoetis livestock: CLARIFIDE Plus, EXCEDE, INFORCE 3 for cattle health
- [Zoetis Equine Products](https://www.zoetis.com/products-and-science/equine): Zoetis equine products: Core EQ, Fluvac, Dormosedan, Pro-Stride APS
- [Aquaculture](https://www.zoetis.com/products-and-science/aquaculture): PHARMAQ aquaculture: fish vaccines and diagnostics for sustainable production
- [Zoetis Diagnostics](https://www.zoetis.com/products-and-science/diagnostics): Zoetis diagnostics: Vetscan OptiCell and AI-powered point-of-care testing

## Research, Innovation & Science

- [Zoetis Research & Development](https://www.zoetis.com/products-and-science/research-development): Zoetis R&D: APOQUEL, CYTOPOINT monoclonal antibodies for animal health
- [Manufacturing & Supply Chain Processes](https://www.zoetis.com/products-and-science/manufacturing-supply): Zoetis manufacturing facilities in Nebraska and Michigan with safety standards
